scientific_integrity: Complete symbolic argument for iff stability criterion, explicit core witnesses and obstruction; finite exact checks independently corroborate small graphs. Publication priority remains subject to independent review.
scientific_limitations: Finite loopless directed graphs with nonnegative weights and additive internal contributions. Total balancedness is universal over all graphs and all induced restrictions retaining external exposures. Full-core uniqueness additionally assumes singleton normalization; not a statement about Shapley tractability or incentive compatibility.
title: An exact insertion-budget criterion for stable directed trust games
